staleHoldTest.uiMessage: Your seat hold has expired or is invalid. Please select your seats again.
staleHoldTest.analysis: Gracefully handled: When hold is non-existent or expired, server returns clean HTTP 404/403 and UI truthfully states "Reservation Not Available" ("Your seat hold has expired or is invalid. Please select your seats again."), without crashing into 500 Internal Server Error.

rootCausesPlainWords.detail: When calculating locked pricing quote, backend previously called 'aud.screen_format.name', 'aud.sound_system.name', and 'aud.projection_type.name'. Because multiple auditoriums in the database have null technical spec relations, this threw an unhandled Python AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'name', causing FastAPI to return HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.
When the frontend served on port 3002, backend ALLOWED_ORIGINS only permitted 3000 and 3001. All credentialed quote fetch requests from port 3002 were rejected by the browser.

The rate limiter executed an 'eval' Lua script for sliding window counters. On local instances where Redis/FakeRedis did not support the exact eval signature, every checkout request threw an exception until the in-memory fallback was attached.
